pairsWith.noteUz: Dam olish joylari va ob-havo lug'ati coursebook 82-bet 1-2-mashqlar va 83-bet 5-7-mashqlarga; 'would prefer to' coursebook 84-betga mos keladi.

scanNote:
WORKBOOK 12-UNITNING BIRINChI BETI (50-bet, PDF 48). Yuqorida to'q sariq yorliqda 'UNIT 12', yonida katta qora 'Holidays with a Difference'.

⚠⚠ MUHIM: KITOBNING 49-BETI (11-unitning OXIRGI beti - Reading/Writing) SKANDA YO'Q! PDF 47 = kitob 48-bet, PDF 48 = kitob 50-bet. Yo'qolgan betlar: 16, 46, 49. Bundan keyin PDF N = kitob N+2. Egasiga xabar berish kerak.

CHAP USTUN - 'Vocabulary':
1a) 'Label the pictures with words from the list.' Qiya: 'hotel, theatre, restaurant, funfair, campsite, gallery'. 6 SURAT: 1 amerikan tog'lari (roller-coaster) - funfair; 2 'RESTAURANT' yozuvli bino; 3 chodir oldida o'tirgan juftlik - campsite; 4 basseynli katta bino - hotel; 5 'STARLIGHT EXPRESS' afishasi - theatre; 6 haykallar/ekspozitsiya - gallery.
1b) 'Which of the following activities can you do at the places above? Make sentences as in the example.' Qiya: 'pitch a tent, have dinner, watch a play, admire paintings, take a ride on a roller-coaster, relax by the swimming pool, order dessert, buy art posters, make a camp fire, call for room service, walk through a haunted house, watch a musical'. Qiya namuna: 'You can pitch a tent at a campsite.'

O'NG USTUN:
2) 'Fill in the gaps using adjectives from the list.' Qiya: 'stormy, sunny, cloudy, snowy, rainy, windy'. 1 It was a ...... day in the middle of January so we made a snowman. 2 It was such a ...... day that my umbrella was blown inside out. 3 Most people like to go on holiday when it is hot and ...... . 4 Half an hour later the weather became very ...... . They could hear the rumble of thunder and they saw flashes of lightening [kitobda shunday; to'g'risi 'lightning'] across the sky. 5 On a ...... night you can't see any stars in the sky. 6 The town's river overflows every year during the ...... season.
3a) 'Match the items in column A to those in column B to say what activity you would prefer to do, as in the example.' A: cloudy, sunny, rainy, windy, stormy, snowy | B: go skiing, go sailing, go to the cinema, stay indoors and read a book, rent a video, go on a picnic. Strelka: cloudy → go to the cinema. Qiya namuna: 'On a cloudy day, I would prefer to go to the cinema.' 3b) 'Can you think of any other activities you would prefer to do?'
4) 'Fill in the correct preposition from the list.' Qiya: 'in, of, with, on, from, at, for'. 1 Buckingham Palace is located ...... the heart of London. 2 The train station is only five minutes away ...... the Museum of Fine Arts. 3 Versailles is one of the most famous palaces ...... the world. 4 You will find fresh fish ...... any time of year in the local market. 5 Los Angeles is located ...... the west coast of North America. 6 Brown's department store offers a wide range ...... board games. 7 The Canary Islands are an ideal place ...... an exotic holiday. 8 After work, Helen likes to relax ...... a good book.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '50'.

exercises.instructionEn: Label the pictures with words from the list: hotel, theatre, restaurant, funfair, campsite, gallery.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarni ro'yxatdagi so'zlar bilan nomlang: hotel, theatre, restaurant, funfair, campsite, gallery.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ 49-BET SKANDA YO'Q (11-unit
  oxiri). Bu bet 12-unit boshi.

DAM OLISh JOYLARI:

  1 funfair - attraksionlar bog'i
    (roller-coaster)
  2 restaurant - restoran
  3 campsite - lager joyi (chodir)
  4 hotel - mehmonxona (basseyn)
  5 theatre - teatr ('Starlight
    Express' - mashhur myuzikl)
  6 gallery - galereya (ekspozitsiya)


⚠ 'A CAMPSITE':

  = chodir tikish joyi, lager.


⚠ 'THEATRE':

  Brit. imlo (AQSh 'theater').


⚠ 'STARLIGHT EXPRESS':

  = Endryu Lloyd Uebber myuzikli
  (1984), rolikda ijro etiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Which of the following activities can you do at the places above? Make sentences as in the example: pitch a tent, have dinner, watch a play, admire paintings, take a ride on a roller-coaster, relax by the swimming pool, order dessert, buy art posters, make a camp fire, call for room service, walk through a haunted house, watch a musical. Example: You can pitch a tent at a campsite.
exercises.instructionUz: Yuqoridagi joylarda quyidagi mashg'ulotlardan qaysilarini qilish mumkin? Namunadagidek gaplar tuzing: pitch a tent, have dinner, watch a play, admire paintings, take a ride on a roller-coaster, relax by the swimming pool, order dessert, buy art posters, make a camp fire, call for room service, walk through a haunted house, watch a musical. Namuna: Lager joyida chodir tikish mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
JOY + MAShG'ULOT (har joyga 2 ta).

  campsite: pitch a tent, make a
    camp fire
  restaurant: have dinner, order
    dessert
  theatre: watch a play, watch a
    musical
  gallery: admire paintings, buy
    art posters
  funfair: take a ride on a
    roller-coaster, walk through a
    haunted house
  hotel: relax by the swimming
    pool, call for room service


⚠ 'TO PITCH A TENT':

  = chodir tikmoq.


⚠ 'A HAUNTED HOUSE':

  = arvohli uy (attraksion).


⚠ 'ROOM SERVICE':

  = xonaga xizmat (mehmonxonada).


⚠ 'A CAMP FIRE':

  = gulxan.

pairs.right: pitch a tent, make a camp fire
pairs.whyUz: ⚠ NAMUNA: 'You can pitch a tent at a campsite.'
⚠ 'You can have dinner at a restaurant.'

pairs.right: watch a play, watch a musical
pairs.whyUz: ⚠ 'You can watch a play at a theatre.'

pairs.rightUz: rasmlarni tomosha qilish, san'at posterlari sotib olish
pairs.whyUz: ⚠ 'You can admire paintings at a gallery.'

pairs.right: take a ride on a roller-coaster, walk through a haunted house
pairs.rightUz: amerikan tog'larida uchish, arvohli uydan o'tish
pairs.whyUz: ⚠ 'You can take a ride on a roller-coaster at a funfair.'

pairs.right: relax by the swimming pool, call for room service
pairs.rightUz: basseyn bo'yida dam olish, xonaga xizmat chaqirish
pairs.whyUz: ⚠ 'You can relax by the swimming pool at a hotel.'

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps using adjectives from the list: stormy, sunny, cloudy, snowy, rainy, windy.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni ro'yxatdagi sifatlar bilan to'ldiring: stormy, sunny, cloudy, snowy, rainy, windy.
exercises.explanationUz:
OB-HAVO SIFATLARI (ot + -Y).

  snow → SNOWY (qorli) - snowman
  wind → WINDY (shamolli) -
    umbrella blown inside out
  sun → SUNNY (quyoshli) - hot
  storm → STORMY (bo'ronli) -
    thunder, lightning
  cloud → CLOUDY (bulutli) - no
    stars
  rain → RAINY (yomg'irli) - river
    overflows


⚠ 'BLOWN INSIDE OUT':

  = ichi tashqariga ag'darilgan
  (soyabon shamolda).


⚠ 'THE RUMBLE OF THUNDER':

  = momaqaldiroq gumburlashi.
  'a flash of lightning' = chaqmoq
  yarqirashi. ⚠ Kitobda
  'lightening' - imlo xatosi,
  to'g'risi 'lightning'.


⚠ 'TO OVERFLOW':

  = toshmoq (daryo).

items.sentence: It was a ___ day in the middle of January so we made a snowman.
items.uz: Yanvar o'rtasida qorli kun edi, shuning uchun qorbobo yasadik.

items.sentence: It was such a ___ day that my umbrella was blown inside out.
items.uz: Shunday shamolli kun ediki, soyabonim ag'darilib ketdi.

items.sentence: Most people like to go on holiday when it is hot and ___ .
items.uz: Ko'pchilik issiq va quyoshli paytda ta'tilga chiqishni yoqtiradi.

items.sentence: Half an hour later the weather became very ___ . They could hear the rumble of thunder and they saw flashes of lightning across the sky.
items.uz: Yarim soatdan keyin ob-havo juda bo'ronli bo'lib ketdi. Ular momaqaldiroq gumburlashini eshitishdi va osmonda chaqmoq yarqirashini ko'rishdi.

items.sentence: On a ___ night you can't see any stars in the sky.
items.uz: Bulutli kechada osmonda yulduzlarni ko'rib bo'lmaydi.

items.sentence: The town's river overflows every year during the ___ season.
items.uz: Shahar daryosi har yili yomg'irli mavsumda toshadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the items in column A to those in column B to say what activity you would prefer to do, as in the example: cloudy, sunny, rainy, windy, stormy, snowy | go skiing, go sailing, go to the cinema, stay indoors and read a book, rent a video, go on a picnic. Example: On a cloudy day, I would prefer to go to the cinema.
exercises.instructionUz: A ustundagi bandlarni B ustundagilarga moslab qaysi mashg'ulotni afzal ko'rishingizni ayting, namunadagidek: cloudy, sunny, rainy, windy, stormy, snowy | go skiing, go sailing, go to the cinema, stay indoors and read a book, rent a video, go on a picnic. Namuna: Bulutli kunda men kinoga borishni afzal ko'rardim.
exercises.explanationUz:
'WOULD PREFER TO' - AFZAL
  KO'RMOQ.

  On a + OB-HAVO + day, I would
  prefer to + fe'l.

  cloudy → cinema (NAMUNA)
  sunny → picnic
  rainy → stay indoors and read
  windy → sailing (shamol kerak)
  stormy → rent a video (uyda)
  snowy → skiing

  ⚠ Boshqa mosliklar ham mumkin
  (rainy → rent a video).


⚠ 'TO RENT A VIDEO':

  = video kasseta ijaraga olmoq
  (1999!).


⚠ 'INDOORS':

  = uyda, bino ichida.

pairs.whyUz: ⚠ NAMUNA (strelka): 'On a cloudy day, I would prefer to go to the cinema.'
⚠ 'On a sunny day, I would prefer to go on a picnic.'

pairs.right: stay indoors and read a book
pairs.whyUz: ⚠ 'On a rainy day, I would prefer to stay indoors and read a book.'
⚠ 'On a snowy day, I would prefer to go skiing.'

exercises.instructionEn: Can you think of any other activities you would prefer to do?
exercises.instructionUz: Afzal ko'radigan boshqa mashg'ulotlarni o'ylab topa olasizmi?

items.en: What other activities would you prefer to do on a sunny / rainy / snowy day?
items.uz: Quyoshli / yomg'irli / qorli kunda yana qanday mashg'ulotlarni afzal ko'rardingiz?
items.answerEn: On a sunny day, I would prefer to go swimming. On a rainy day, I would prefer to play computer games. On a snowy day, I would prefer to make a snowman.
items.answerUz: Quyoshli kunda suzishga borishni afzal ko'rardim. Yomg'irli kunda kompyuter o'yinlari o'ynashni afzal ko'rardim. Qorli kunda qorbobo yasashni afzal ko'rardim.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct preposition from the list: in, of, with, on, from, at, for.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan to'g'ri predlogni qo'ying: in, of, with, on, from, at, for.
exercises.explanationUz:
PREDLOGLAR (coursebook 83-bet
  6-mashq - Alton Towers matnidan).

  IN the heart of London - qoq
    markazida
  five minutes away FROM - ... dan
    5 daqiqa
  IN the world - dunyoda
  AT any time of year - yilning
    istalgan paytida
  ON the west coast - g'arbiy
    sohilda
  a wide range OF - keng tanlov
  ideal FOR - ... uchun ideal
  relax WITH a book - kitob bilan


⚠ 'THE HEART OF':

  = ... ning qoq markazi.


⚠ 'A WIDE RANGE OF':

  = keng assortiment.


⚠ 'BOARD GAMES':

  = stol o'yinlari (shaxmat,
  monopoliya).


⚠ 'THE CANARY ISLANDS':

  = Kanar orollari (Ispaniya).

items.sentence: Buckingham Palace is located ___ the heart of London.
items.uz: Bukingem saroyi Londonning qoq markazida joylashgan.

items.sentence: The train station is only five minutes away ___ the Museum of Fine Arts.
items.uz: Poyezd vokzali Tasviriy san'at muzeyidan atigi besh daqiqa uzoqlikda.

items.sentence: Versailles is one of the most famous palaces ___ the world.
items.uz: Versal dunyodagi eng mashhur saroylardan biri.

items.sentence: You will find fresh fish ___ any time of year in the local market.
items.uz: Mahalliy bozorda yilning istalgan paytida yangi baliq topasiz.

items.sentence: Los Angeles is located ___ the west coast of North America.
items.uz: Los-Anjeles Shimoliy Amerikaning g'arbiy sohilida joylashgan.

items.sentence: Brown's department store offers a wide range ___ board games.
items.uz: Brown's univermagi stol o'yinlarining keng tanlovini taklif qiladi.

items.sentence: The Canary Islands are an ideal place ___ an exotic holiday.
items.uz: Kanar orollari ekzotik ta'til uchun ideal joy.

items.sentence: After work, Helen likes to relax ___ a good book.
items.uz: Ishdan keyin Xelen yaxshi kitob bilan dam olishni yoqtiradi.

patterns.formula: You can + MAShG'ULOT + at a + JOY.
patterns.exampleEn: You can pitch a tent at a campsite.

patterns.formula: On a + OB-HAVO + day, I would prefer to + FE'L.
patterns.exampleEn: On a cloudy day, I would prefer to go to the cinema.
patterns.exampleUz: Bulutli kunda kinoga borishni afzal ko'rardim.

patterns.formula: It was such a + SIFAT + day that + NATIJA.
patterns.exampleEn: It was such a windy day that my umbrella was blown inside out.
patterns.exampleUz: Shunday shamolli kun ediki, soyabonim ag'darilib ketdi.

patterns.formula: X is located in the heart of / on the coast of ...
patterns.exampleEn: Buckingham Palace is located in the heart of London.
patterns.exampleUz: Bukingem saroyi Londonning qoq markazida joylashgan.

groups.ruleUz: ⚠ QO'ShMA OT: camp + site, fun + fair, snow + man
